tbesh_html:
1) to domineer, exercise power over, dominate, have mastery, be master, lord it over
1a) (Qal) to domineer, lord it over, become master
1b) (Hiphil)
1b1) to give power of
1b2) to get mastery of
Aramaic equivalent: she.let (שְׁלֵט "to rule" H7981)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: to dominate, i.e. govern; by implication, to permit
strongs_1890.kjv_def: (bear, have) rule, have dominion, give (have) power.
